description: Generate scalable vector graphics (SVG) using Gemini. Creates clean, production-ready SVG code for diagrams, illustrations, icons, and data visualizations. Returns inline preview with SVG viewer. [MCP_RECOMMENDED_TIMEOUT_MS: 240000]

model.description: Omit to use gemini-3-flash-preview. Other valid options: gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-pro-preview.

outputPath.description: Optional file path to save the SVG (e.g. C:/output/diagram.svg)

prompt.description: Description of the SVG graphic to generate

style.description: Visual style: technical (diagrams), artistic (illustrations), minimal (simple), data-viz (charts)

name: generate_svg
title: Generate SVG Graphic
